sql.query: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), start_dt, 120) AS start_dt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), end_dt, 120) AS end_dt FROM tb_kabm_calendar_global WHERE seq_no = ?

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, start_dt, 112) AS start_dt, CONVERT(VARCHAR, end_dt, 112) AS end_dt, (CASE WHEN start_dt > end_dt THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) as change_yn FROM ( SELECT (CASE WHEN GETDATE()+1 <= start_dt THEN start_dt ELSE GETDATE()+1 END) AS start_dt, end_dt FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AS start_dt, CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AS end_dt ) t ) tt
SELECT (CASE DATEPART(DW, CONVERT(DATETIME, ?)) WHEN 1 THEN 'N' WHEN 7 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS change_yn

SELECT seq_no, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, start_dt, 120), 0, 17) start_dt, CASE WHEN is_allday = 'Y' and start_dt = end_dt THEN SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, start_dt, 120), 0, 12) + '23:59' ELSE SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, end_dt, 120), 0, 17) END as end_dt, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, CASE is_allday WHEN 'Y' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END as is_allday, schdl_cntnt FROM tb_kabm_calendar_global a WHERE start_dt >= CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AND end_dt <= CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AND glbl_schdl_type = ? AND schdl_nm like '%'+'$search_word'+'%'

MERGE INTO tb_kabm_calendar_global a USING (SELECT ? seq_no) b ON (a.seq_no = b.seq_no) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.start_dt = CONVERT(DATETIME, ?), a.end_dt = CONVERT(DATETIME, ?), a.schdl_nm = ?, a.glbl_schdl_type = ?, a.is_allday = ?, a.schdl_cntnt = ? WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (start_dt, end_dt, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, is_allday, schdl_cntnt) VALUES (CONVERT(DATETIME, ?), CONVERT(DATETIME, ?), ?, ?, ?, ?);

mapping.setProperty: seq_no, start_dd, end_dd, schdl_nm,glbl_schdl_type, is_allday,schdl_cntnt, start_dd, end_dd, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, is_allday, schdl_cntnt

sql.query: SELECT seq_no, CONVERT(CHAR(10), start_dt, 23) start_dt, CONVERT(CHAR(10), end_dt, 23) end_dt, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(19), start_dt, 0),12, len(CONVERT(CHAR(19), start_dt, 0))) start_time, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(19), end_dt, 0),12, len(CONVERT(CHAR(19), end_dt, 0))) end_time, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, CASE is_allday WHEN 'Y' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END as is_allday, schdl_cntnt FROM tb_kabm_calendar_global a WHERE glbl_schdl_type = ? and ( start_dt between CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) and CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) OR end_dt between CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) and CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) )

mapping.getProperty: seq_no, start_dt, end_dt, start_time, end_time, schdl_nm, schdl_type,is_allday,schdl_cntnt

sql.query:
select top (?) no, seq_no, start_dt, end_dt, start_time, end_time, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, is_allday, schdl_cntnt, tot_cnt from ( select row_number() over(ORDER BY start_dt) no, seq_no, start_dt, end_dt, start_time, end_time, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, schdl_cntnt, CASE WHEN start_dt = end_dt THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END as is_allday, COUNT(*) OVER() tot_cnt from ( SELECT seq_no, glbl_schdl_type, schdl_nm, schdl_cntnt, CONVERT(CHAR(10), start_dt, 23) start_dt, CONVERT(CHAR(10), end_dt, 23) end_dt, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(19), start_dt, 0),12, len(CONVERT(CHAR(19), start_dt, 0))) start_time, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(19), end_dt, 0),12, len(CONVERT(CHAR(19), end_dt, 0))) end_time FROM tb_kabm_calendar_global a WHERE start_dt >= CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AND end_dt <= CONVERT(DATETIME, ?) AND schdl_nm like '%'+'$search_word'+'%' AND glbl_schdl_type = ?
) z ) k where k.no > (?-1) * ?

mapping.setProperty: row_per_page, start_dt, end_dt, search_schdl_type, cur_pg, row_per_page
mapping.getProperty: no, seq_no, start_dt, end_dt, start_time, end_time, schdl_nm, glbl_schdl_type, is_allday, schdl_cntnt, tot_cnt
